en: An old monochrome postcard-style photograph depicting the ruins of a large stone castle on a low hill by a river or lake. The walls are partially collapsed, with several tall sections of masonry still standing. In the foreground, three men in early 20th‑century clothing stand by and in a small rowboat among rocks in the shallow water. The scene has a calm, reflective surface of water, and the overall image has a greenish tint typical of vintage postcards. In the upper left corner there is printed text identifying the view.
